speaker: Elder Edward Dube
title: Come unto Christ
session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder Edward Dube spoke about “Come unto Christ”.

quotes.text: President Oaks asked that it be removed to avoid any impression of exclusion. Rather, we invite all to come unto Christ through faith in Him and His Atonement. In that moment, I gained the desire to love others as the Savior does. I love Him. I know He lives. He suffered for me in Gethsemane; “his sweat was as it were great drops of blood.” He suffered for me on the cross at Golgotha. I cannot comprehend that suffering, but I testify of His divinity.
quotes.speaker: Elder Edward Dube
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: His suffering and atoning sacrifice show us how completely devoted He is to all of us. He invites us to come unto Him. Consider Moroni’s invitation: “Yea, come unto Christ, and be perfected in him, … deny yourselves of all ungodliness.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Edward Dube
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: President Russell M. Nelson taught: “Perfection is pending. It can come in full only after the Resurrection and only through the Lord. It awaits all who love Him and keep His commandments.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Edward Dube
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: There I am praying and panicking at the same time—I have never smoked a day in my life. What do I say? “Heavenly Father,” I pleaded, “please put words in my mouth.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Edward Dube
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Sister Child shared this with me later: “I stayed awake all night because I couldn’t bear watching Randall suffer—wanting to be perfect in every way possible. So all night I cried and pleaded with the Lord to help him. In the early hours of the morning, the answer came very clear: ‘Randall doesn’t need to be perfect. He needs to do the very best he can.’”
quotes.speaker: Elder Edward Dube
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Randall added: “I had trust in the Lord. But when I heard Laurin praying for me—saying all I needed to do was the best I could—I knew then that she was an answer to my prayers.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Edward Dube
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Brothers and sisters, let us consider Laurin’s answer to her prayer. The Lord said, “He needs to do the very best he can.” Randall didn’t perfect himself to come to Christ. He came to Christ—with prayer, with trust, and with a willing heart. The Savior, through His grace, helped him to let go of what was holding him back.
quotes.speaker: Elder Edward Dube
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: And that is why President Oaks had the sign on the gate taken down: “Trespassers will be prosecuted.” The adversary wants to hang that sign on the gate of our heart. Addiction, doubt, pride, pain, grief, guilt, materialism—or whatever is holding us back—he tells us this makes us unworthy to come unto Christ.
quotes.speaker: Elder Edward Dube
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference
